title: Kona
description: Kona was one of the pirates of Captain Silvo's crew, then Captain Brutus's when he took over. When Silvo, also known as Jod Na Nawood, was captured by Brutus once more, he gave a rousing speech and told Kona that she deserved a pirate fleet of her own. Convinced of this, she switched loyalties again and gave Silvo another chance.
